\section{TPU Results}\label{sec:RDMA}
A graphics processing unit (GPU) runs each kernel of \examplesys{}. % XYZ is a comment
In 80\% of runs, the message passing interface (MPI) carries the data.
Each MPI rank reads its input (Section~\ref{sec:RDMA}; see \cite{HBM, NVLink}).
The error is $\mathrm{RMSE} < 10^{-3}$, \(\mathrm{MAE}\) stays small, and
\[ \mathrm{SNR} = 1 \]
\begin{equation}
  \mathrm{PSNR} = 2
\end{equation}
The tool sets \texttt{LD\_PRELOAD} and prints \verb|FPGA| once.\\% the ASIC note
